caption: The drawing depicts a pattern featuring several large and small round fruits colored in shades of pinkish-red, attached to leafy green stems. The foliage consists of multiple elongated and pointed leaves rendered in dark green, with the stems and leaf outlines in black. The fruits are distributed across a mottled tan or light brown background. Along the top edge of the drawing, there is a decorative horizontal border with a scalloped design in white and tan, adorned with curved black and purple shapes and small dot patterns, outlined with black accents. The overall composition is arranged in a repeating, naturalistic manner, with the plant elements oriented in various directions.
title: Wall Decoration
